content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High error rate from external vendors impacting verification flows. Observed: Twilio 5xx/429 and SendGrid 500s for the last 18m in us-west. Impact: delayed/failed SMS + email verifications (>30s latency, some 500s). Pager: P1.

pagerduty: @sara you have the P1 (oncall). Please acknowledge.

sara: ack — I'm on it. starting triage. Can folks drop quick observations?

mike: seeing lots of 502/504 from twilio API to /Messages and 500s from SendGrid v3/mail/send. Traffic spike correlates with a campaign from customer-b.

jess: customer-success flagged 2 big customers: AcmeCorp and BrightHealth. They report ~20% of OTPs failing or arriving minutes later.

alyssa: checking routing policies — we have provider-failover configured but looks like requests are still pinned to twilio-us-west due to region header in the routing key. fallback didn't kick because the error codes are 429/5xx but also some partial success responses that confuse our health checker.

sara: important — we need a quick mitigation: 1) open fallback to secondary provider (sms-proxy-2) bypassing region pinning, 2) increase retries/backoff for SendGrid calls, 3) notify CS. Who can flip the routing safely?

mike: I can flip route config. Will do a controlled change to route verification traffic to secondary pool. Posting command to run:

```
# switch provider routing for verification namespace
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"namespace":"verify","route_override":"sms-proxy-2","force":true}' \ 
  https://console.internal/api/routing/override
```

mike: executing now.

ops-bot: change requested by mike queued. audit id: audit-20260315-7721.

mike: rolled. routing change applied — verification traffic now going to sms-proxy-2. I'll monitor.

sara: monitor metrics — latency/error delta please. Also increase short-lived queue slots so we don't drop inbound verification attempts during retries.

alyssa: queue slots bumped + resubmission enabled for 5m window. Also disabled region pinning for verify namespace.

carmen-cs: posting note to affected customers: "We're experiencing degraded SMS/email verifications due to third-party vendor issues. We are rerouting and expect improvements within ~15 minutes. Will update." :pray:

jess: thanks. CS asked for an ETA — do we have rough percent of traffic impacted?

mike: pre-change: verification error rate 18%, avg delivery latency 45s. post-change: error rate down to 6% and latency median ~6s for SMS via sms-proxy-2. SendGrid still showing intermittent 500s for mail/send in us-west.

sara: good improvement on SMS. For email, let's enable our secondary sendgrid key / alternate region (sendgrid-eu) for transactional route. Alyssa can you flip?

alyssa: on it. switching transactional-email pool to sendgrid-eu for verify namespace. Command: `route set transactional-email verify sendgrid-eu --force`

alyssa: done. monitoring. SendGrid 500s in us-west drop as traffic shifts.

pagerduty: @nate please prepare to take over the incident in 30m for oncall handoff.

nate: copying. I will shadow for 30m then take lead.

sara: update for timeline: 18:03 - initial pager. 18:12 - route override to sms-proxy-2. 18:20 - queue bump + region pin disabled. 18:28 - email route changed to sendgrid-eu. Metrics improving but still watching.

mike: telemetry: overall verification success now ~95%. Some retries still pending for backlog; backlog processing rate ~avg 200/s.

jess: CS: customers are seeing improved deliveries. AcmeCorp reports most verifications working now. BrightHealth still saw delays but much reduced.

sara: mitigation checklist: confirmed route override, queue bump, email region failover, notified CS, drafted status to customers. Next: postmortem ticket, ensure health-check logic is updated to trigger failover earlier on mixed failure patterns.

alyssa: filed internal ticket INFRA-987 to make health-checkers treat 5xx/429 spike with partial success as unhealthy. Also adding sticky-region TTL so we don't pin forever.

incident-bot: Incident status updated to: "mitigated". Assigning owners for postmortem.

nate: taking control for handoff. Sara — any remaining actions you want me to own?

sara: please keep monitoring for 2h, validate backfill processing finishes, and coordinate with platform to release postmortem draft. Also confirm with Billing/CS whether any customers need credits.

carmen-cs: will follow up on credits and send customer round 2 message with final ETA.

mike: scheduled a rollback guard in case secondary provider starts degrading — I added an automated fallback to pause new verification sends to preserve capacity then notify oncall.

sara: thanks team. final note before handoff: root cause likely a third-party regional outage + our health-check logic not aggressive enough for mixed-error states. We'll include that in RCA.

nate: acknowledged. taking it from here.

incident-bot: Incident transitioned to "monitoring".

carmen-cs: status update posted to customers at 18:48: "Reroutes successful; deliveries improving. We continue to process backlog and will send another update in 2 hours."

jess: creating postmortem doc and assigning initial draft to sara + alyssa + mike.

sara: thanks. handing off. :white_check_mark:

nate: incident owner now. I'll post final resolution when backlog is cleared and all metrics normal for 2h.

incident-bot: Incident resolved at 20:05. Final impact: ~12% peak verification failures, ~95% success after reroutes; estimated users affected ~4.2k verification attempts in window. Follow-up: postmortem assigned to infra-team, action items due in 7 days.

jess: :thumbsup: closing thread once postmortem live.

carmen-cs: thanks all.
